title: yencoding: LineIter does not implement std::iter::Iterator
description:
Why this exists: yencoding/src/decode.rs defines a private struct LineIter<'a> with a manual fn next() method, but it does NOT implement the std::iter::Iterator trait. This means LineIter cannot be used with for loops, iterator adaptors (.map(), .filter(), etc.), or any function expecting an Iterator.

What goes wrong: code that wants to iterate lines cannot chain .enumerate(), .peekable(), or any adaptor onto LineIter. The natural Rust API is unusable. Any refactor that tries to pass LineIter to a generic fn expecting Iterator will fail to compile. The iterator abstraction is broken — it looks like an iterator but is not one.

Fix: impl Iterator for LineIter<'a> with type Item = &'a [u8] and delegate to the existing next() body.
